profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer III @ Tatari
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with proven track record of designing and implementing low-latency and high performance systems, leverating AI/ML models for data driven decision making, and optimizing system performance for cost and resource savings.

Building and optimizing current troubleshooting tools. Lead weekly meetings with supervisors and managers to address new issues, calculate goals for the semester, and develop new

positions.title: Front Desk Supervisor
positions.description:
Training and supervision of all Sales Associates and Secondary Front-End supervisors on all front-end policies and procedures.
Timely communication to store management of any issues and coordinating immediate pre-screening of all applicants by store management.
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures through proper handling of all transactions and corresponding documentation.
